# smbCloud

> smbCloud is a developer platform that brings four services together so small teams get enterprise power at startup velocity: Deploy ships Node.js, Ruby on Rails, and Swift/Vapor apps with one command (live logs, fast rollbacks); Auth handles sign-in, accounts, and collaborators; Mail routes your domain email; and GresIQ runs your database. One platform instead of four vendors.

Website: https://smbcloud.xyz/
Organization: smbCloud
Company: Splitfire AB
Location: Stockholm, Sweden
Contact: support@smbcloud.xyz
GitHub: https://github.com/smbcloudXYZ

## Products
- smbCloud Deploy: SSH-first application deployment for Node.js, Ruby on Rails, and Swift/Vapor — one command, live logs, fast rollbacks.
- smbCloud Auth: hosted authentication — sign-in, signup, sessions, collaborators, and account management. https://smbcloud.xyz/auth
- smbCloud Mail: domain mail routing, forwarding, and stored inbound mail. https://smbcloud.xyz/mail
- GresIQ: the data and memory layer for AI apps — Postgres-backed documents, realtime, row-level security, and vector search. https://gresiq.com/
